title: Power Platform Developer
summary: Power Platform developers build business apps and automated workflows on Microsoft's low-code tools (tools where much of the app is built visually): Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse. They work with business teams in an IT, digital or consulting group and replace spreadsheets and email processes with apps.
dailyDuties: Build canvas and model-driven apps in Power Apps
Build Power Automate flows for approvals and alerts
Design Dataverse tables and security roles
Connect apps to SharePoint, SQL and other systems
Meet business users to gather requirements
Move solutions from test to production

skills.expectation: Build canvas and model-driven apps with Power Fx
Build cloud flows for approvals, alerts and data sync
Design Dataverse tables, relationships and security roles
Use SharePoint lists and libraries as app data sources
Connect apps to other systems through connectors and REST APIs
Turn business requests into app and flow designs
Demo apps to business users and explain trade-offs
Embed or build Power BI reports for the apps
Write JavaScript or PCF code where low-code is not enough
Use Azure Functions or Logic Apps behind custom connectors
Move solutions between environments with pipelines
Query SQL Server data used by apps

certifications.why: Many postings pair Power Apps with Power BI
Basics of the Azure services used with Power Platform
